name: unity-2-5d-character
description: Produce modular 2.5D Unity RPG characters from master design through eight-direction skeletal actions, equipment, Animator, runtime and QA using 13 skills.

interface.shortDescription: 13 skills for master design, skeletal actions and Unity character production
interface.longDescription: Start from canonical character identity and proportions, create eight direction masters and overlapping modular parts, build a shared Unity 2D rig, author arbitrary skeletal actions, integrate equipment and runtime behavior, and validate production through persistent specifications. Requires the separately installed official Unity plugin and a connected target Editor on every skill invocation.
defaultPrompt: Use $character-production-orchestrator. Start a new Unity character from master-character. Do not skip stages.
Use $animation-clip-authoring. Create SwordLightAttack for South using the canonical character specs.
Use $character-production-qa. Inspect my character rig, equipment, animations and runtime.
